message.content:
The image is a vertical magazine cover with a red border. In the center, a man wearing a black cap, white long-sleeved shirt, and light-colored pants sits atop a white carousel horse. He holds a brown handle attached to a belt around his waist. Behind him, another man with white hair and a blue shirt sits on the horse's back, leaning toward a red rectangular coin box. His right hand drops a small yellow object into a slot on top of the box.

The carousel horse is white with tan accents around its eyes, nose, and mane. The background features blurred yellow, white, and red circles of light. At the top, yellow text reads “KASASI PAHIT UNTUK HOTASI” above a large white “TEMPO” logo. Below the logo is the date “19-25 MEI 2014.” White text on the left identifies “Prabowo Subianto & Hatta Rajasa.” At the bottom right, large white block letters spell out “DUET KEPEPET.” A barcode and the price “RP 35.000” are in the lower-left corner.
